title: CuratedItemFile
description: One curated item file (domain-model.md §15.1 header, kind fields, `[[param]]`, `[[effect]]`).

default_caster.description:
Buffs: caster of a pick without one (04 §4.2 `caster`; `ally` for T-13 Roar, spec 00 §6.1 T-37). Addition,
CONTRACTS.md T01d.

excluded_lines.description:
Conditional stat lines of the upstream text that no effect of the file implements: excluded from every
bucket, never applied as unconditional, and listed in the data-build report (04 §5.3 "Uncatalogued
conditional lines"; `DataKey::CheckConditionalLineExcluded`). Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

inspiration_key.description: Buffs and custom stats: the inspiration's link key (`"o.r"`, `"p.a"`).

name.description: Must equal the catalogue English name (checked).

scope.description: Default scope of every effect whose own scope is the default.

status.description:
verified | draft | unmodelled | no_damage_effect (`auto` and `stale` are pipeline states, rejected by the
validator in authoring files).

strength_scaled.description: Buffs: value = listed(rank) · Str of the caster (04 E-4.10).

subsumable.description: Buffs: offered in the Helminth slot (09 §10).

toggle.description: Buffs: the toggle the buff implements (`"T-13"`).

$comment: GENERATED by `cargo xtask gen-schema` (wfd-model) — never edit by hand. Curated TOML files of pipeline.md §6.1. OutcomeFilter.description:
Hit-outcome gate: the effect applies only to instances whose own rolls satisfy it (`{ crit = "none", status =
"none" }`). Procs of extra hits do not count. EV: the kernel adds the term only on the branch k = 0 with weight
P(k = 0)·P(no proc of the instance); MC: evaluated live after the rolls. A DSL construct of the architecture review
(work-breakdown.md §2.4, R-2): no 04 catalogue row uses it since 04's second tail round made Laetum Overwhelming
Attrition an on-hit buff whose trigger is [`TriggerId::OnPlainHit`] and which later instances use whatever their
own rolls (04 §5.12, D-410).

dps_dr.description:
05 §15.3 (Orphix): points `[X_dps, DR]`, X ascending, read with [`SpecialDrDef::dps_multiplier`] (the only
reading; CONTRACTS.md T03b review fixes). The interpolated quantity is the **effective DPS**
`g(X) = X·(1 − DR(X))`, not DR: g is linear between consecutive points, the last segment continues beyond the
last point, and M_dps(X) = g(X)/X (X ≤ the first point: 1 − DR of the first point). Linear in g is exactly
E-5.22's bands M = a + b/X; interpolating DR linearly is wrong inside every band and goes negative at high X.

`rules/special_dr.toml` (05 §4.4-4.5, §15; T03b): `[[dr]]` definitions and `[[enemy]]` hand rows keyed by

SpotSource.description:
A weak-spot source σ of 02 E-2.10 (toggle T-32, spec 00 §6.1): the effect's value is the factor s_σ of one
highlighted node (Sonar 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 × Str by ability rank, Detect Vulnerability up to 2.75; 02 §4.10 "Weak
spots", 04 §5.6), and the two named params of the item hold the user's location L_σ and node count ν_σ, so the
T-32 inputs are `buffs[].params` of the scenario. The engine multiplies the sources as
`M_son = Π_σ s_σ^(ν_σ·spot_σ)` (not the "members add" rule of other groups), and a source with spot_σ = 1 on a
direct hit makes the instance a weak-point hit (domain-model.md §14). TOML
`spot = { location = "spot_location", nodes = "spot_nodes" }`. Addition, CONTRACTS.md T01d.

location.description:
Choice param of the item holding L_σ: `"hit_part"` (the T-03 part; the param's default) or `"torso"` (the
body part; reaches radial instances), 02 E-2.10.

nodes.description:
Number param of the item holding ν_σ ≥ 1 (the exponent of s_σ; Sonar default 1); `None` = one node
(Detect Vulnerability, "always 1", spec 00 §6.1 T-32).

StackModel.description:
Own stack counter of an effect (04 §4.2 field names and values). `consume_on`, `reset_on` and the `idle` decay
are 04 §4.2 fields added here (CONTRACTS.md, T01a). TOML
`stacks = { max = 2, bind_max = "n4", duration = 20.0, bind_duration = "n3", stack_timer = "shared_lose_one" }`.

duration.description: Seconds at maximum rank; 0 = no timer (user-driven stacks of class (c) and (u)).

duration_rank.description:
Per-rank rule of `duration` (09 E-9.13 covers durations; X-RANK: Primary Plated Round
`{ table = [3.0, 4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 8.0, 10.0] }`, Double Tap `linear`). `None` = the same at every rank.

max.description: Stack cap m at maximum rank; with `unbounded`, the default stack count of the user input instead.

max_rank.description:
Per-rank rule of `max` (09 E-9.13 covers stack caps; X-RANK: Double Tap's table 80, 40, 26, 20). `None` = the
same cap at every rank; `linear` = `max·(r + 1)/(R + 1)`; a table lists ranks 0 ..= R and its last entry
equals `max`. Addition (CONTRACTS.md, T01a fixes).

unbounded.description:
No cap (04 §4.2 `max_stacks = none`, 04 §5.5 Magus Accelerant "no limit"): the effect is a class (c) or (u)
user count whose `CondOverride::Stacks` may exceed `max` (`max` is its default). Event-driven counters
without a cap are `counter_bonus` with `unbounded` (ruling C-4, CONTRACTS.md T01d).

StackTimer.description: Expiry rule of a stack counter (04 §4.2).

default.description:
Default value in its JSON form (compact encoding: JSON text, because postcard is not self-describing).
Absent in a readable form = JSON `null` (TOML has no null, so `rules/toggles.toml` omits the key of an
off-by-default toggle; addition, CONTRACTS.md T03b).

field.description:
Path in `ScenarioDoc` (`"toggles.hit_location"`, `"eval.window_s"`); addition for server-api.md §5.6. The
place of the toggle in `TOGGLE_MAP`: several paths separated by `|`, `"buffs"` for the buff toggles (the
value is the buff pick's param `value`, rendered by the buffs panel), a `BuildDoc` path prefixed `build.` and
an optimizer-request path prefixed `opt.` (`rules/toggles.toml`, CONTRACTS.md T03b). A generic control
(every kind but [`ControlType::Custom`]) writes its value at the single path `field`.

ToggleGroup.description: Group of a toggle in the schema-driven panels (data: `"conditions"`, `"melee"`, `"enemy"` …).

oneOf.description: The entry's `Hits`.
The attack's `Multishot`.

TriggerId.description:
Trigger ids of 04 §4.1: every (b) and (c) id of its table, plus `OnMeleeInput` and `OnThrow` (07 §7.5, §9.4).
`OnBigCrit`, `OnFire`, `OnMiss`, `OnDodge` and `HealthLevel` were added by T01a; `WhileFiring`, `OnPlainHit`,
`WhileAirborne`, `WhileCrouching`, `WhileMoving` and `OnPull` by T01d (CONTRACTS.md), appended after the T01a ids so
the compact form's variant indices stay unchanged. 04's `hits_within(k, Δt)` ("k hit units within Δt s": Final
Tap, Triple Tap, Sudden Justice) is `CountWithin { of: OnHit, n: k, window: Δt }`, the hits counted in the
`hit_unit` of the condition. TOML: `"on_kill"`, `"on_plain_hit"`, `{ on_status = "SLA" }`, `{ combo = 3 }`,
`{ count_within = { of = "on_headshot", n = 2, window = 2.0 } }`, `{ on_melee_input = "light" }`.

(c) While airborne (Soaring Strike, 04 §5.3).
(c) While crouching (Lie In Wait, 04 §5.3).
(c) While moving (04 §4.1).
(c) Pulling an enemy with the alternate fire (Exposing Harpoon, 04 §5.3).

Normal Attack × S_j (exalted waves, 9.8).

TypeSelRepr.description: Readable form of [`TypeSel`]: a list of type IDs or `{ param = "element" }`.

UniqueName.description:
Permanent identity of anything in the bundle. DE items use their DE path
(`"/Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Pistol/AutoPistol"`). Things DE does not export use our namespace `"wfd:<kind>/<slug>"`,
e.g. `"wfd:buff/roar"`, `"wfd:enemy/grineer/lancer"`, `"wfd:perk/furis/haven_foray"`, `"wfd:custom/base"`,
`"wfd:shard/violet/primary_electricity"`. Enemies have synthetic names `wfd:enemy/<wiki sub-module>/<slug>`.

Upstream.description: `upstream = { field = "wiki.Description", text = "+165% Damage", sha256 = "9b1c…" }` (written by `curate rebind`).

ValueDecay.description: Value decay (04 §4.2): `linear` over the duration, `garuda` (04 §3.1), `idle` after `t_idle` s without a trigger.

rate.description: Value lost per second while decaying (fraction).

t_idle.description: Seconds without a trigger before the decay starts.

ValueTable.description:
Table form of [`ValueRepr`]: exactly one of the key groups `max` (+ `rank`, `bind`), `variants`, `param`,
`base` (+ `add`), `scalar` + `values`.

VulnMask.description:
Vulnerability mask: the damage types and layers a vulnerability multiplies (05 E-5.19). TOML
`vuln = { types = ["HEA"] }`, `vuln = { types = { param = "element" } }`,
`vuln = { types = ["PUN"], layers = ["OG", "SH", "HP"] }`.

Defaults follow the spec, not domain-model.md §11.1 ("layers default all"): a mask without `layers` applies to
health only (05 §13 "An entry without an explicit mask applies to health only (Decision)"; 04 §4.2 `layer_mask`
default `{HP}`, §5.7 "`{HP}` unless the U37 list above names it"), and a mask without `types` applies to every
type (04 §4.2 `type_mask` default `all`). Request C-14 of CONTRACTS.md.

layers.description: Layers the vulnerability applies to; default `{HP}` (not the all-layer default of [`LayerSet`]).

types.description: Damage types the vulnerability applies to; default every type.

WeaponClass.description:
Weapon class for effect scopes and riven classes (melee subclass: `MeleeData.class`).
`Crossbow`, `DualShotguns` and `Tome` are wiki classes named by spec 09 §3.1 (CONTRACTS.md, T01a).

WeaponFilter.description:
Weapon part of a scope. Empty lists accept every weapon. `melee_classes` and `traits` are additions for the
weapon-class scopes of 04 §4.2 (`weapon_class_scope`: glaive, battery, beam …; CONTRACTS.md, T01a).

traits.description: The weapon must have every listed trait.

WeaponSlot.description: Equipment slot of a weapon record.

XhPart.description: Body-part factor of an extra hit.

XhStatus.description: Status behaviour of an extra hit.
